title: TagDuel automatic decision-timeout transaction rollback under SQLite write faults
scenarios: At the exact decision deadline, a SQLite trigger aborts the terminal transition-event insert inside getTag. The session row, winner, revision, serialized state, event rows and all four participant locks must remain unchanged; retrying the same deadline after removing the trigger must finish the duel and release all locks.

At the exact decision deadline, a SQLite trigger aborts deletion of the participant locks after getTag writes the terminal state and event. The transaction must roll back; retrying the same deadline must persist exactly one terminal event and remove all four locks.
invariants: The 30-minute decision timeout is evaluated at its exact deadline.
Timeout winner, terminal status, revision, transition event and lock release are atomic.
Failed timeout persistence does not consume, duplicate or reassign physical card UIDs.
Player rows and player_cards remain unchanged.
Retrying the same deadline after a transient SQLite failure produces one terminal transition.
limits: Tests use temporary SQLite and real compiled TagStore/TagDuel modules.
Fault injection covers SQL trigger aborts, not process termination or filesystem corruption.
No runtime, resolver, catalog manifest, allowlist, persistent database or player data is modified.
This is a TagDuel persistence regression and certifies no new card behavior.
No live Discord API session is performed.
command: npm run check && npm run build && node --test tests/tagTimeoutRollbackAtomicity2v2.test.cjs
